verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs describe OpenAI-compatible chat/completions endpoints and a general 'model catalog' concept, but no evidence cites a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint for programmatic catalog enumeration, and probes for openapi.json/docs.md/llms.txt all returned 404s, indicating no discoverable API spec confirms this endpoint. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a GET /v1/models (or equivalent) endpoint, any programmatic listing example, and a working OpenAPI/machine-readable spec confirming it.
